meta.name: budget-optimizer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "allocate my influencer budget", "optimize spend across tiers", or "compare budget scenarios"; produces a tier/platform/content allocation table, ROI and CPM/CPE projections, scenario comparisons, and mid-campaign reallocation moves. Not for building the full campaign plan — use campaign-planner.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分配网红预算并优化投放层级
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责网红营销预算分配与效果优化
copy.tagline_en: Allocate influencer budget and optimize spend across tiers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage influencer marketing budget and ROI optimization

howto.what: 当用户要求分配网红预算时，Claude 会生成一个预算分配表，包含层级/平台/内容类型，并给出 ROI、CPM/CPE 预测、多场景对比以及中期重新分配建议。
howto.when: 当用户提出“分配我的网红预算”、“优化各层级支出”或“比较预算方案”等请求时触发。也适用于规划新活动预算、模拟保守/激进场景或中期重新分配。

say.text: 帮我分配一个3万美元的Instagram和TikTok网红活动预算。
say.note: Claude 会生成预算分配表和预测结果。

say.text: 比较5万和10万美元两种预算方案，针对Z世代产品发布。
say.note: Claude 会并排展示两种场景的分配和ROI。

say.text: 根据当前表现，重新分配中期预算。
say.note: 需要提供已花费金额和每个网红的效果数据。

howto.what_en: When asked to allocate influencer budget, Claude produces a tier/platform/content allocation table with ROI, CPM/CPE projections, scenario comparisons, and mid-campaign reallocation recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "allocate my influencer budget", "optimize spend across tiers", or "compare budget scenarios". Also for planning new campaigns, modeling scenarios, or mid-campaign reallocation.

say_en.text: Allocate a $30,000 budget for an influencer campaign on Instagram and TikTok.
say_en.note: Claude generates allocation table and projections.

say_en.text: Compare a $50K and a $100K scenario for a Gen Z product launch.
Reallocate mid-campaign budget based on current performance.
